name: kb_580_Normalized

schema.description: NamespaceSpec describes the attributes on a Namespace.

finalizers.description: Finalizers is an opaque list of values that must be empty to permanently remove object from storage. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/namespaces/

description:
The namespace is presently guarded by three finalizers. The first is the standard Kubernetes namespace finalizer, **kubernetes.io/namespaces**, which ensures that core cleanup steps are performed before the namespace can be fully removed. The second is a custom finalizer registered by our team at **example.com/custom-finalizer**, allowing us to execute additional shutdown logic specific to our applications. The third entry in the list is a null value, indicating an empty placeholder where no further finalizer is defined.

Because Kubernetes requires this finalizer list to be empty before a namespace can be permanently deleted from storage, all three entries—including the null placeholder—must be cleared in the proper order to complete the namespace removal process.
